answers.finding: No U.S. label record for afatinib available in the provided evidence.
FDA AEMS Q3 2024 reviewed TLS signal for lenvatinib and determined no action necessary; no US label update indicated.
US label (Poteligeo v21) lists immune-mediated colitis in section 6.2 Postmarketing Experience only.
US label v36 (effective 2026-02-09) includes hyperammonemic encephalopathy warning in section 5.1 Hepatotoxicity

The US label for Zoloft (sertraline) version 7 (published 2025-07-24) contains no mention of MADD, glutaric acidemia type II, acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency, fatty acid oxidation disorder, metabolic decompensation, or mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation defect in any section.
Bactrim (sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim) U.S. label v18 (effective 2024-12-30) includes circulatory shock in WARNINGS and ADVERSE REACTIONS sections.

U.S. label for axicabtagene ciloleucel (Yescarta v23, effective 2026-08-06) does not list immune-mediated enterocolitis or immune effector cell-associated enteritis; full-label search found 2 sections matching related terms but not the specific reaction.

Xtandi US label v24 (effective 2026-07-28) includes warning in Section 5.8 and Drug Interactions 7.3 about interference with certain digoxin immunoassays causing falsely elevated digoxin plasma concentrations.

US label (v18, March 2025) does not list hallucinations unrelated to serotonin syndrome in warnings, contraindications, adverse reactions, or patient counseling; cited sections (Contraindications 4, Adverse Reactions 6, Patient Counseling 17) address serotonin syndrome but not hallucinations as a separate non-serotonin-syndrome reaction. Section 5 (Warnings and Precautions) was not provided in the records, so its content cannot be confirmed.
